fusions.name: Long-Ridden Charge
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Dust-Cloud Trample
fusions.desc: Tramples through a short cone ahead of you, dealing 6 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Warm From the Ride
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds and 6 health at once. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Unsaddled
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
